description: A flat desk is in front of you with a white remote lying near the center and a black monitor on a stand to the right. The right hand moves in from the right to the remote, grips it as a right-hand object, lifts and aims it toward the monitor as if clicking, then lowers and sets the remote back on the desk and briefly picks it up to point again, while the left hand stays mostly resting on the desk without touching any object.
